tasks-for-deciding-the-no-pin-model.text: Tasks for deciding the no-pin model.
As the ticket owner, I want independently reviewable evidence at each stage, with semantic decisions reaching the operator before dependent work.

Tasks marked done carry the ticket owner's acceptance of their slice (bind and investigate; identity statements); every other task is pending. Task names are descriptive; accepted task stamps belong to the ticket owner. Source paths denote owners, not blanket writable permission: freeze each stage's exact fence.

setup-and-authority.text: [x] Bind accepted inputs — Confirm the revisions/digests and upstream acceptance status in specs/741-no-pin-model/authority.md and base-hashes.json; obtain exact #679/#680 references without entering their working lanes. Requirement: Bound authority.

[x] Record baseline checks — Run the scoped model/application baselines through nix/model.nix and root justfile; retain actual command/exit receipts in the ticket runtime. Requirements: Bound authority; Traceable decision and consumers.

[x] Freeze the changed-obligation inventory — Add specs/741-no-pin-model/impact.md covering old/new definitions, theorem statements, observations, consumers and dispositions. Requirement: Traceable decision and consumers.

identify-the-registry-priority-p1.text: Independent outcome: a reader can inspect exact identity premises and replay the same-seed cases, without claiming the whole design is accepted.

[x] Inventory identity premises — Read lean/Singular/Model/Registry.lean, the bound ledger/history sources and the application model; record exact hash/ledger premises with satisfying-witness obligations in impact.md. Requirements: Explicit identities; Satisfiable premises.

[x] Freeze candidate call surfaces — Complete the hypothetical identity signatures in functions-model.md and owned records in data-model.md before implementing candidate files. Requirements: Explicit identities; Bound authority.

[x] Model identity and role cases — In the frozen investigations/741-no-pin/ files, state executable naming/application dependencies and state/witness/request-tag classification, including a genuine witness carrying a fabricated state datum. Requirements: Explicit identities; Authenticated asset roles.

[x] State same-seed history obligations — In the same candidate namespace, distinguish multiple policies in one transaction from repeated spending across history; preserve any concrete counterexample. Requirement: Scoped history uniqueness.

[x] Audit identity statements — Independent auditor checks exact statement hashes, reachable/satisfiable premises, completeness and finite mutation floor; ticket owner records the result in impact.md and runtime. Requirements: Satisfiable premises; Scoped history uniqueness; Authenticated asset roles.

[ ] Prove or refute identity claims — After statement approval, supply proofs or constructive witnesses in the frozen candidate modules; semantic findings go to decisions.md. Requirements: Explicit identities; Satisfiable premises; Scoped history uniqueness; Authenticated asset roles.

follow-the-genuine-holding-priority-p1.text: Follow the genuine holding — priority P1.
Independent outcome: the candidate explains legitimate creation, custody and retirement and exposes incompatible application requirements.

[ ] Bind application and economic effects — Map OpenDatumApplication/Model.lean, root Model/Termination.lean and Economics/ obligations into impact.md, retaining every economic parameter and controller/release obligation. Requirement: Consumer and economic agreement.

[ ] State supply and release obligations — Freeze signatures, then candidate statements for unknown-key mint, permanent no-remint, exact same-key burn/transition, pending custody and excluded/mixed cases in investigations/741-no-pin/. Requirements: Permanent key supply; Consumer and economic agreement.

[ ] Audit then prove holding claims — Independent statement audit precedes proof or constructive refutation; retain the selected reachable and mutation witnesses, and record any release/custody conflict in decisions.md. Requirements: Permanent key supply; Consumer and economic agreement.

explain-reader-conclusions-priority-p1.text: Independent outcome: each reader class has an exact observation contract, with unavailable evidence kept distinct.

[ ] Specify observation requirements — Complete contracts/model-observations.md from the candidate and the accepted reader vocabulary; exhibit active custody, pending, never-registered, terminal and unavailable cases. Requirement: Honest reader conclusions.

[ ] Audit then establish observation claims — State and independently review the relevant observation theorems before proofs; retain incomplete/wrong-release controls in the frozen candidate corpus. Requirement: Honest reader conclusions.

decide-and-align-consumers-priority-p1.text: Decide and align consumers — priority P1.
Independent outcome: the operator receives an exact decision packet; implementation remains held until that decision and alignment.

[ ] Obtain the soundness ruling — Present the actor/start/action/outcome and concrete evidence for every unresolved semantic question; record the user's words and scope in decisions.md. Requirements: Bound authority; Consumer and economic agreement; Traceable decision and consumers.

[ ] Align only approved laws — After the ruling, version the writable fence and align affected root/application model declarations, statements and constitution translation; update impact.md with every preservation/restatement/retirement. Requirements: Consumer and economic agreement; Traceable decision and consumers.

[ ] Regenerate model consumers — Update the affected lean/*corpus.json, theorem registers, applications/open-datum/ exports, simulator/ mirror, conformance/coverage/ identities and public model/economics/theorem explanations through their existing tools. New implementation claims remain uncovered. Requirement: Traceable decision and consumers.

[ ] Verify the exact candidate — Run model, application, simulator and affected docs/presentation checks; commission fresh independent final audit and collect exact-head hosted results. Requirement: Traceable decision and consumers.

[ ] Publish the decision handoff — Update quickstart.md, PR template and impact.md with candidate identities, proofs/refutations, operator decision and unmeasured/unsupported boundaries. Keep landing held until epic sequencing permits it. Requirement: Traceable decision and consumers.

dependencies-and-parallel-work.text: Authority binding precedes every candidate stage. Identity premises precede dependent supply/release proofs. Statements are audited before their proofs. Reader claims depend on the corresponding identity/custody meaning. The ruling precedes accepted-law amendments and implementation; consumer generation follows its approved revision.

One commit owner writes at a time. Auditor reads frozen candidates in a separate checkout. No author/auditor shared index. Independent source inventory can continue while an unrelated ruling is pending. No parallel research or simulator seat is authorized.
